nodes.label: Evolution instance webhook configuration
nodes.evidence_scope: documented content; implementation and runtime not independently verified
nodes.description: Use per-instance webhook with x-webhook-secret for MESSAGES_UPSERT, MESSAGES_UPDATE and CONNECTION_UPDATE; global Compose webhook remains disabled.

nodes.label: Server side secrets and sanitized AI facts
nodes.evidence_scope: documented content; implementation and runtime not independently verified
nodes.description: Agents never access the database; AI facts omit CPF, telephone, email and payments; browser never receives internal credentials.

nodes.label: Explicit bootstrap and seed configuration
nodes.evidence_scope: documented content; implementation and runtime not independently verified
nodes.description: No default credentials; admin bootstrap requires configured email and at least 12-character password; seed replaces demonstration data and must be environment-appropriate.
